product.name: KALLAX shelving unit 4×2
product.note: Simplified guide: dowels, cam locks, nails and screws aren’t shown. Your paper manual shows which to use.

steps.title: Bottom and long dividers
steps.instruction: Lay the bottom panel on its front edge. Push the 3 long dividers onto its dowels.
checklist: The dividers stand straight up from the bottom panel

steps.title: Stand it up
steps.instruction: Get a second person to help. Tip the KALLAX shelving unit 4×2 up onto its bottom edge, as the animation shows.
steps.warning: Fix it to the wall with the wall fitting before you use it. Furniture that tips over can injure people.
checklist: It stands level on all corners
It is fixed to the wall

faq.answer: The wall fitting is included, but the wall plugs and screws depend on your wall. Ask a hardware shop which ones suit it.
